name: The Witch and the Prince
source:
A witch's son moves into a cabin in the forest after his mother's passing. He grieves in solitude until someone knocks at his door... Is the princely figure standing in his doorstep an enemy? A friend? Or maybe...

[From [url=https://maxmorkson.itch.io/the-witch-and-the-prince]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
母亲去世后，女巫的儿子搬进了森林里的一间小屋。他独自悲伤，直到有人敲门……站在他家门口的王子身影是敌人吗？朋友？或者也许…

[来自[url=https://maxmorkson.itch.io/the-witch-and-the-prince]itch.io[/url]]
